regions.today: A dry, frosty and icy start in parts this morning with sunny spells. Cloud will build from the south during the morning and afternoon with persistent rain following and extending to all areas. Becoming windy too with southeasterly winds increasing fresh to near gale force and gusty with the arrival of the rain. Highest afternoon temperatures of 4 to 7 degrees.
regions.tonight: Wet and windy early tonight with widespread rain and a fresh to strong southeasterly wind. The rain will gradually clear northeastwards overnight and will be followed by clear spells, scattered showers and lighter winds. Lowest temperatures of 3 to 8 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will bring scattered showers and sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 8 to 12 degrees in a moderate west to southwest wind easing light to moderate southerly.
